name: ca-foundation-qa
title: CA Foundation — Quantitative Aptitude (Paper 3)
assets_note: Diagrams and images are disabled for v1. The Core retains the asset machinery for future exams that need it.

v1_scope.intent: Prove the core loop on the simplest, most computational, diagram-free slice of Paper 3, then widen across the full taxonomy.
v1_scope.deferred_reason: Calculus is heavy notation. Direction tests, seating arrangements, and graphical statistics need diagrams or spatial rendering the v1 app does not support.
v1_scope.open_question: Confirm whether the very first pilot narrows further, for example Business Mathematics only, before widening to all in-scope families.
